public_reaction.summary: No analyst action or press headline on today's print found by 09:20 ET; one search returned only older quarters.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 30.10 (-8.5%) against prev close 32.88, active pre-market (193 prints, 25 in the last 30 min, last 09:15, not stale). Range 35.04 to 27.80: the tape spiked above yesterday's close (likely on the IEEPA-flattered EPS beat) and then sagged as the guide was read. -8.5% is well short of the -17% release read and inside the 12.8% implied move, while the Q2 guide miss did -30.5%. Headwind: SPY +1.2%, IWM +1.8% pre-market, and 18% of float short. Short already +6.6% vs 13:30 entry (32.13).

thesis_check.note: The panel shorted on a Q4 guide below the street after Enphase's weak Q4 guide; SEDG guided Q4 $245-275m against $319-343m, with margins stepping down sharply.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market so the open should hold the -8.5%; the guide miss is unambiguous and larger than what the pre-market prices, and the run-up-then-sag pattern says the read is still extending, against a generic gap give-back, a strong tape (IWM +1.8%) and an 18% short float.

recommendation.limit_basis: The pre-market low already printed (27.80, about -15.5% vs prev close), close to the -17% release read and inside the Q2-analogue range; a cover limit there captures most of the move the release supports if the session extends the gap, and the position goes at the close otherwise, which is where a bmo reaction that is still repricing should be.
recommendation.reason: De vooruitzichten voor het vierde kwartaal liggen zo'n 20% onder wat analisten verwachtten en de marges dalen sterk; de winst per aandeel van Q3 ziet er alleen goed uit door een eenmalige tariefteruggave. De koers staat voor de opening pas ruim 8% lager, minder dan dit nieuws rechtvaardigt, dus houden we de short aan met een kooporder om te dekken op 27,80; wordt die niet geraakt, dan sluiten we bij het slot.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 terugloopt naar boven de 31,50 (een squeeze in een sterk stijgende markt), dan liever direct bij de opening dekken.
